mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification must remain enabled in every build, including development builds. There are no exceptions for any build environment: the same verification policy applies uniformly across development and production, so that development behavior does not diverge from production behavior.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
